verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly from left to right: brand, then the one-line headline, then the badges, then the CTA. But the phone and its circle are cut off at the top and bottom edges, the 'Find It Near You' button is jammed against the right edge with its text almost touching the button's sides, and the tagline is tiny. B keeps the phone whole but leaves it isolated, with a big dead gap before the copy. 'SOLSTICE' floats off to the left of the headline instead of sitting above it, the two-line headline is cramped, and the badges and CTA are stacked in an odd 2x2 grid that makes the CTA the same width as a badge, so it no longer stands out as the action.
